GOLF ADVISORY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 4, 2026
  2760 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  PRM ADMINISTRATION, LARGE CONFERENCE ROOM, 2:30 PM

Kevin Fitzgerald, Chair  Jim Demetriou, Member
Larry Conkings, Vice Chair  Robert Meliere, Member
Clifford Aichele, Member  Joyce Ricci, Member
Stevie Anderson, Member  Angie Young, Member
Donna Barrett, Member

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to
  lilia.romero@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55299  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Golf Advisory Committee meeting
  of Thursday, March 12, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55311  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the Annual Report from the
  Office of Ethics and Transparency.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55312  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the Ralph M. Brown Act
  from the Office of the City Attorney.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55313  Recommendation to receive and file the City Golf Operations oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-55314  Recommendation to receive and file the American Golf oral updates on the
  courses, capital improvement projects, and other items.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-55315  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees,
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2
   GOLF ADVISORY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 4, 2026
  2760 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  PRM ADMINISTRATION, LARGE CONFERENCE ROOM, 2:30 PM

CHAIR AND VICE CHAIR ELECTION

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Golf Advisory Committee on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited
to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Lilia Romero, Clerk Typist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the
meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact Lilia Romero at 562.570.3104 or
Lilia.Romero@longbeach.gov
